title: MUPA$^{2}$E: Multimodal Unified Perception with Asymmetric Attention for Emotion Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2608.15999v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic emotion assessment can benefit from combining neural and behavioral signals, but many multimodal approaches rely on separate, modality-specific feature-extraction pipelines before fusion. This paper presents MUPA\textsuperscript{2}E, a unified perception framework that processes facial video and electroencephalography (EEG) through a single shared asymmetric-attention backbone. Facial video is represented through axis-folded frame tokens, while EEG is processed either as a raw multichannel waveform or projected into the spatial domain for multimodal fusion. The framework is evaluated on the DMER dataset under a stratified subject-independent protocol, comparing unimodal video, unimodal EEG, and fused video--EEG configurations with per-channel and merged EEG projections. translated_title: MUPA$^{2}$E：基于非对称注意力的多模态统一感知用于情绪评估
translated_abstract: 自动情绪评估可以从结合神经和行为信号中获益，但许多多模态方法在融合前依赖于独立的、特定模态的特征提取流程。本文提出了MUPA\textsuperscript{2}E，一个统一感知框架，通过单个共享的非对称注意力骨干网络处理面部视频和脑电图（EEG）。面部视频通过轴折叠帧令牌表示，而EEG则作为原始多通道波形处理或投影到空间域进行多模态融合。该框架在DMER数据集上采用分层受试者独立协议进行评估，比较了单模态视频、单模态EEG以及融合视频-EEG配置，其中包含逐通道和合并EEG投影。使用原始录音，较短试验通过零填充以匹配最长持续时间，步长为30的合并融合达到了最高验证性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于非对称注意力的统一多模态感知框架MUPA$^{2}$E，通过共享骨干网络同时处理面部视频和EEG信号，在DMER数据集上实现了更优的情绪评估性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MUPA$^{2}$E, a unified asymmetric-attention framework that jointly processes facial video and EEG signals through a shared backbone, achieving superior emotion assessment performance on the DMER dataset.
